title: ALIGNED AGENTS, BIASED SWARM: MEASURING BIAS AMPLIFICATION IN MULTI-AGENT SYSTEMS

bias_targets.methodology: Forcing comparative judgments in a multiple-choice benchmark (Discrim-Eval-Open) among protagonists with distinct ages, and measuring the amplification of probabilistic preferences across multi-agent system iterations using metrics like the Gini coefficient, variance, and entropy.

Forcing comparative judgments in a multiple-choice benchmark among protagonists of different genders (Male, Female, Non-binary), and measuring the amplification of probabilistic preferences across multi-agent system iterations using distributional metrics.

Forcing comparative judgments in a multiple-choice benchmark among protagonists of various races and ethnicities (e.g., Asian, White, AI/AN, Black, Hispanic), and measuring the amplification of probabilistic preferences across multi-agent system interactions.
